name: Should I use a prefabricated shower or tiled shower in an ADU bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Which shower type is better for cost, durability, and speed in a small ADU bathroom?
mainEntity.text: Which shower type is better for cost, durability, and speed in a small ADU bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best shower type depends on the goals of the project. A prefabricated shower is usually faster to install, simpler to waterproof, and often more budget-friendly. A tiled shower gives more design flexibility and can feel more custom, which may fit a luxury ADU better. However, tiled showers take more labor, require careful waterproofing, and can be more expensive to repair if something fails. In a small ADU bathroom, a prefabricated base with well-chosen wall finishes can be a smart middle-ground if the goal is speed and durability. If the project is intended for a higher-end rental or guest suite, a tiled shower may better match the rest of the home, but the contractor should explain the maintenance tradeoffs. Homeowners should compare not just the look, but also the installation time, leak risk, and long-term upkeep. The right answer depends on whether the priority is budget, speed, or a custom finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: A prefabricated shower is usually faster and often cheaper, while a tiled shower offers more design flexibility and a higher-end look. For small ADUs, the best choice depends on budget, timeline, and how much maintenance the owner wants. Tiled showers need excellent waterproofing and more labor.
